task: Sun: thin the layered look, slower burn with frame blending, sheet choice by constant
usage_note: map.gd, planet shader and the three sheets in art/ untouched. sun_flare frames re-cut from v02, identical. sun_flare global parameter and set_radius() kept.
open_questions: Look at it in a real window: is 5 planes x glow 0.4 bright with visible structure, or too dim/too sparse? Tune PLANES and PLANE_GLOW in sun_flare.gd.
Is 3 FPS burn slow enough, and is the crossfade smooth (no visible pulsing at frame steps)? Tune FPS.
handoff: PLANES 12 -> 5, PLANE_GLOW 0.55 -> 0.4 (set from sun_flare.gd; sum at full overlap 2.0 instead of 6.6). Planes keep Fibonacci yaw/pitch, own crop centre, scale, rotation, frame phase and off-centre depth. FPS 12 -> 3 (const FPS); the shader already linearly blends frame f and f+1 (linear on purpose: smoothstep would stall at each frame). sun_flare brightness now also blends between the two frames, so the planet light follows the picture smoothly. Sheet: const SOURCE in sun_flare.gd = sun_flare (v02), or sun_storm (v01) or sun_calm (v03). cut_sun.gd now cuts all three sheets. Picked v02: it is the current look with a few flares, between the storm and the calm one.
